en: The image shows a grand building with four distinctive round towers capped with red domes and a central spire, reflected in a large body of water. The structure is surrounded by manicured gardens, with trees and smaller buildings in the foreground. The text 'Kgl. Jagdschloss Moritzburg.' is printed at the top in red letters. The image is bordered by tree branches overhead and tall grasses at the bottom near the water's edge.
